card.name: Dosage wording in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word dose or dosage (or its start) right after recommended or starting, and the space before a mg amount after 'increments of'. Seen in dosing sections for psychiatric and ADHD drugs.

modes.label: Warning about your child
modes.description: The word your in a warning to call the doctor about a child's new symptoms.
modes.example: Call your doctor right away if you or<< your>> child has any new or worsening mental symptoms
